# M.A.R.S. USA
M.A.R.S. USA presents M.A.R.S. COMPANION LLC and its offline personal AI companion project to organisations in the United States. The company was founded in Kapan, Armenia, and is led from there.
Started in Kronstadt. Born in Pushkin. Founded in Kapan, Armenia. Built for the World.
## At a glance
### What M.A.R.S. is
M.A.R.S. (Mobile Autonomous Reasoning System) is a personal AI companion and digital personality project designed to work without depending on the cloud.
### Who is behind it
M.A.R.S. COMPANION LLC, a company incorporated in the Republic of Armenia. Its founder and director is Aleksandr Sarkisian.
### Connection status
M.A.R.S. USA is the national website and point of dialogue for the United States. Status: establishing connection.
## Why the United States
The United States is home to one of the world's largest technology and research ecosystems. It is a priority region for the international development of M.A.R.S. COMPANION LLC and a key place for dialogue about the future of personal AI.
## Part of a global presence
Founded in Kapan, Armenia, M.A.R.S. COMPANION LLC is developing a presence in the European Union and the United States.

# M.A.R.S. technology
M.A.R.S. — Mobile Autonomous Reasoning System — is an offline personal AI companion and digital personality project developed by M.A.R.S. COMPANION LLC.
## Design principles
### Offline by design
M.A.R.S. is designed to run locally on the user's own hardware, so personal interaction does not depend on remote servers.
### A personal voice companion
It is built for spoken conversation with one person over the long term, rather than anonymous one-off queries.
### Long-term memory and personality
M.A.R.S. is conceived as a digital personality with a stable character and long-term memory across conversations.
### Privacy as a starting point
No mandatory accounts, subscriptions or remote data collection. What a person shares stays with them.
## Development status
M.A.R.S. is under active development. Product specifications, availability and release dates have not been published.
We will describe capabilities publicly once they can be demonstrated, and not before.
## What we do not publish
Technical architecture, unpublished research and work related to intellectual property are confidential. Detailed technical discussions take place only within a formal framework, such as a non-disclosure agreement.
## Further reading
The technology page of M.A.R.S. International is the central reference for the project.

# Research & Technology
Our R&D focuses on one question: what it takes to build a personal AI companion that works offline and stays consistent over time.
## Areas of interest
### Offline reasoning
Approaches that allow useful reasoning on personal devices with limited resources and without constant connectivity.
### Continuity and personality
How a digital companion can maintain a coherent character and context over long periods of use.
### Human–AI interaction
Trust, transparency and healthy boundaries in long-term interaction between a person and an AI companion.
### Privacy-preserving design
Design choices that keep personal information under the control of the person it belongs to.
## Researchers in the United States
We welcome contact from universities and research institutions in the United States working in related fields. No research collaboration in the United States has been established to date.
No research publications have been released yet.

# Cooperation
We are open to dialogue with organisations in the United States that share an interest in personal, privacy-respecting AI.
## Who we would like to hear from
### Research institutions
Groups working on reasoning, human–AI interaction or privacy who see a fit with our areas of interest.
### Universities
Faculties and departments interested in academic dialogue, joint questions or student projects.
### Companies
Technology and industry partners with a related interest in personal or offline AI.
### Public-sector organisations
Institutions interested in responsible, privacy-respecting AI for people.
## How a conversation starts
- Initial contact Write to us with a short description of your organisation and the topic you have in mind.
- Introductory call We arrange a conversation to understand mutual interests.
- Confidentiality Where confidential information is involved, we agree a non-disclosure framework first.
- Defined scope Any cooperation is based on a written agreement with a clear scope.
## Start the conversation.

# Privacy Policy
This policy explains how personal data is handled when you visit usa.teduza.com. Last updated: 20 November 2026.
## 1. Controller
- Company: M.A.R.S. COMPANION LLC
- Country: Republic of Armenia
- E-mail: contact@teduza.com
## 2. What this website does not do
- It does not set cookies and does not use local browser storage.
- It does not use analytics, advertising or tracking tools.
- It does not embed third-party content, and fonts are served from this website itself.
- It contains no forms; no data is collected through the pages.
## 3. Server log data
When you open a page, the hosting provider that delivers this website may automatically process technical data such as your IP address, the date and time of access, the requested address and information about your browser. This is necessary to deliver the website and keep it secure.
For visitors in the European Union, the legal basis is our legitimate interest in operating a secure website (Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR).
## 4. Contacting us by e-mail
If you write to us, we process your message and contact details only to respond to your enquiry and for any follow-up correspondence. We do not pass them on to third parties for marketing.
## 5. Your rights
Depending on the law that applies to you, you may have the right to access, rectify or erase your personal data, to restrict or object to its processing, and to data portability. Visitors in the European Union may also lodge a complaint with a data protection supervisory authority. To exercise your rights, contact us at the e-mail address above.
## 6. Changes
We will update this policy if the website changes in a way that affects personal data, for example if analytics or a contact form are introduced.
